description: Transient (pre-developed-window) explanatory power of static shielding
reason: PX5's S_h_static/S_h_dynamic comparison is computed ONLY over the stable/developed window (stable_growth_gate's developed_interval); no PX5 analysis characterizes the TRANSIENT (first ~20um) approach to that window. The raw event-by-event data needed to do so IS archived in px5_event_ledger.json (every event, including the transient ones), so this is a genuinely available-but-unanalyzed limitation, not an unrecoverable data gap.

Explicitly out of PX5's prescribed scope (D2/D5 only, per the review's own scope-restriction instruction: 'do NOT expand to D1/D3/D6 without new prospective reason'). No physical trajectories exist for this comparison and none were launched to manufacture one.
